## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
RISK-OFF — Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive; confirmed by weak overall breadth (≤4/11) and broad megacap tech weakness with NVDA (1W: -2.75% | 1M: -1.20%) BELOW TREND, GOOGL (1W: -3.11% | 1M: -7.41%) BELOW TREND and META (1W: -6.25% | 1M: -3.24%) BELOW TREND. Leadership concentrated in Healthcare/Financials while Communication and Technology show clear weakness.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Healthcare leads: MDT ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.65% | 1M: +5.24%), ABT ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.39% | 1M: +5.53%), UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.04% | 1M: +8.76%). Energy showing support: XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.21% | 1M: +1.51%), MPC ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.32% | 1M: +7.01%). Financials stable: WFC ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.67% | 1M: +2.47%), C ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.22% | 1M: +3.82%).

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Technology lagging: MSFT CORRECTION (1W: -7.46% | 1M: +0.87%), AAPL CORRECTION (1W: -1.51% | 1M: +7.00%), NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -2.75% | 1M: -1.20%). Communication weak with AMZN BELOW TREND (1W: -9.09% | 1M: -10.53%). Consumer Discretionary pressured: TSLA BELOW TREND (1W: -10.28% | 1M: -1.94%).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: MDT ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.65% | 1M: +5.24%), ABT ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.39% | 1M: +5.53%), WFC ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.67% | 1M: +2.47%), CVS ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.44% | 1M: +10.44%), DE RECOVERY (1W: +7.61% | 1M: -1.39%). Leadership: Concentrated (3/5 Healthcare) — narrow relative to a broad market advance.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: F CORRECTION (1W: -14.56% | 1M: +23.98%), QCOM CORRECTION (1W: -13.66% | 1M: +12.55%), AVGO BELOW TREND (1W: -13.66% | 1M: -9.33%), INTC BELOW TREND (1W: -13.52% | 1M: -12.25%), INTU BELOW TREND (1W: -10.49% | 1M: -23.62%). Weakness concentrated in large-cap Technology and select discretionary names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Strongest 1W movers include MDT ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.65% | 1M: +5.24%), DE RECOVERY (1W: +7.61% | 1M: -1.39%), ABT ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.39% | 1M: +5.53%); watch for major divergence as multiple megacaps show 1W ≠ 1M moves (MAJOR divergence) — tactical only until confirmed.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Tech is in broad pullback with multiple leaders BELOW TREND: NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -2.75% | 1M: -1.20%), GOOGL BELOW TREND (1W: -3.11% | 1M: -7.41%), META BELOW TREND (1W: -6.25% | 1M: -3.24%); AAPL CORRECTION (1W: -1.51% | 1M: +7.00%) and MSFT CORRECTION (1W: -7.46% | 1M: +0.87%) show short-term pullbacks inside longer run-ups. Sector breadth negative and a source of the RISK-OFF signal.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials mixed but resilient: WFC ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.67% | 1M: +2.47%), C ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.22% | 1M: +3.82%), BAC ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.86% | 1M: +0.95%), JPM RECOVERY (1W: +4.36% | 1M: -0.80%) — pockets of strength support selective cyclical exposure but not broad risk-on.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare showing defensive leadership: MDT ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.65% | 1M: +5.24%), UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.04% | 1M: +8.76%), LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.39% | 1M: +14.82%). Sector acting as safe-haven within the RISK-OFF backdrop.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor selective exposure to defensive/quality names in Healthcare and higher-quality Financials (e.g., MDT ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.65% | 1M: +5.24%), WFC ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.67% | 1M: +2.47%)); reduce exposure to high-beta Tech names showing CLEAR weakness (NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -2.75% | 1M: -1.20%), AMZN BELOW TREND (1W: -9.09% | 1M: -10.53%)). Style: mixed/defensive given leadership concentration and weak breadth.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: MDT ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.65% | 1M: +5.24%) — momentum confirmed; UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.04% | 1M: +8.76%). BEARISH: NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -2.75% | 1M: -1.20%), AMZN BELOW TREND (1W: -9.09% | 1M: -10.53%) — watch for further distribution.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Healthcare (acting defensively; breadth positive within sector), Energy (supporting market floor). BEARISH: Technology and Communication — key megacaps remain under pressure and drive broader sentiment.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
NVDA BELOW TREND — watch break of near-term support at prior swing lows (1W: -2.75% | 1M: -1.20%). AAPL CORRECTION — monitor 1M uptrend support (1W: -1.51% | 1M: +7.00%). WFC ABOVE TREND — watch continuation above recent 1W strength (1W: +5.67% | 1M: +2.47%).

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
GOOGL (+80): Berkshire $10bn stake headline; price GOOGL BELOW TREND (1W: -3.11% | 1M: -7.41%) — sentiment bullish but price diverging (distribution risk to monitor). ABBV (+80): EU approval headline; ABBV not in top list but sector Healthcare supportive — cross-ref price likely confirming given sector strength. EOG (+80): cash-return pledge; EOG in Energy which is positive this week — sentiment confirms price action.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
INTU (-50): TurboTax probe headline; INTU BELOW TREND (1W: -10.49% | 1M: -23.62%) — sentiment confirms price weakness. SHOP (-55): scrutiny headline; SHOP (Technology) not in top lists and likely under pressure — sentiment confirms risk. COF (-50): Q1 miss headline; COF in Financials — monitor for idiosyncratic stress despite sector resilience.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF, style mixed/defensive. Healthcare and select Financials showing relative strength (MDT ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.65% | 1M: +5.24%), WFC ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.67% | 1M: +2.47%)). Key risk: major divergence among megacap Tech (NVDA, GOOGL, MSFT, AMZN) with bearish sentiment on several names — watch for follow-through before adding risk.
